init.title: NS Reisadvies options
init.description: These settings apply to every route under this integration.

data_description.api_key: Your NS API subscription key. Replace if it has been rotated.
data_description.scan_interval_minuten: How often the integration polls the NS API. Allowed range: 1 to 60.
data_description.fav_hours: How long to keep a pinned favourite before it is removed automatically. Set to 0 to disable expiry.
data_description.fetch_composition: Adds an extra NS API call per unique train per refresh to retrieve the actual carriage composition (number of carriages, rolling-stock type, image). Off by default to save API quota.
data_description.live_train_map: Adds a small map icon under the departure platform of each leg. Tapping it opens a map showing the route, stops, and the live train position. The position is only fetched while the map is open.
data_description.live_map_refresh_seconds: How often to refresh the train's GPS position while the live map is open. Faster means smoother movement but slightly more network traffic. Range: 5 to 60 seconds.
